correctness.rationale: Directly rebuilt 12 cube edges, 48 automorphisms, all 107 matchings, 1,385 strict chains and 55 distinct complete-flag orbit cells. Every one of 27 elementary collapses independently checks unique incidence with multiplicities, maximal coface and residual face closure, leaving exactly one zero-cell. The proof includes the equivariant barycentric subdivision homeomorphism; no field computation is used to substitute for topology.
